newsitem.title: FRANCE: Yemen buys EU flour, optional white wheat.
newsitem.headline: Yemen buys EU flour, optional white wheat.

text.p: Yemen bought 200,000 tonnes of European Union soft wheat flour and 200,000 tonnes of optional white wheat, European grain traders said on Thursday.
Yemen bought the wheat flour and the wheat grain from a local operator in Yemen at prices exporters described as "very low".
Yemen bought the wheat at $171 per tonne, including cost and freight, they said.
The wheat is for shipment between June and August and is likely to come from the U.S. or Australia, they said.
One exporter said Yemen bought the EU flour for shipment between February and June at $265 per tonne, cost and freight.
But another exporter cited a price as low as $260 per tonne, cost and freight.
They said the seller may face difficulties covering the contract as most offers to sell EU flour submitted at the tender were around $275 per tonne.
